help.title: Help Menu
help.description: Use `{prefix}help <command>` for more information on a command.
Show all commands or details of one command.

language.description: Show or change the bot language for this server.

prefix.description: Change the bot's prefix for this server.

join.description: Join the voice channel you are currently in.

loop.description: Set the loop mode: off, track, or queue (no argument cycles through them).

nowplaying.description: Show the song that is currently playing.

play.description: Play a song (name or URL) or add it to the queue.

random.description: Play a random song (optionally from a genre or artist).

remove.description: Remove a song from the queue by its position.

stop.description: Stop playback and clear the queue (the bot stays in the channel).
